turning isolated intelligence into coordinated action.
[Multiple gas storage tanks are lined up, showcasing safety ladders and railings for secure access.]

## Expertise earned over a century.

For over a century, we’ve tackled the most pressing challenges in industries where failure has real
consequences: In refineries, hospitals, data centers, buildings and manufacturing plants.
[A construction worker wearing a safety vest and helmet ascends a spiral staircase, emphasizing
safety on site.]

## Intelligence set in motion.

Across the globe, companies run their most critical operations on our technologies. Today, we
harness the intelligence inside them, turning individual assets into synchronized systems that
continuously learn, adapt — and amplify human potential.

customers already rely on, adding intelligence that learns from their operations, proposes
improvements, and acts only with their approval.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]
[A person wearing a headset interacts with a holographic display of 3D models and data
visualizations.]

### Realize LIVE 2026 | Global events

Join us to explore the future of engineering, simulation and industrial AI. Pick your location and
register now.

[Register now][9]
**Technology**

## Upgrade reality

The challenges of tomorrow demand an upgrade today. We power your ideas with artificial
intelligence, simulation and smart technologies, moving you from digital blueprint to real-world
impact.

This review examines how microscopy and computational analysis can identify defects in
self-assembled nanosphere structures used in photonics, sensing, coatings, drug delivery, and
nanosphere lithography. It concludes that multimodal imaging, standardized datasets, and
data-efficient machine learning could improve quantitative inspection and feedback-guided assembly.

# Graduations

## Congratulations to all of our students graduating this summer.

[ Find out more about graduation ceremonies ][18]

# Summer 2026 graduations are here

## Celebrate your achievements

Now your studies are complete, it’s time to celebrate everything you've achieved with your loved
ones in the magnificent surroundings of Bath Abbey.

It's a moment to reflect on your university experience, look ahead to the future, and receive the
award you've worked so hard for.

## Raise a glass at your graduation reception

After the ceremony, join your department’s drinks reception to celebrate with friends, family,
tutors, and other University staff who have supported you throughout your studies.

## Hot weather forecast during graduations

Bath Abbey will be hot during the graduation ceremonies.

To help yourself keep cool, please bring:
* your own water bottle - we're not able to provide drinking water in the Abbey
* a handheld fan

You don't need to wear a suit jacket during the ceremonies, but you should wear light and breathable
clothing under your gown.

## Beijing Ultrasonic: Your Global Partner for Advanced Ultrasonic Engineering

Beijing Ultrasonic stands at the forefront of acoustic engineering, delivering high-performance
industrial ultrasonic cleaning equipment and core components to a global market. With over 15 years
of dedicated manufacturing expertise, we provide comprehensive solutions designed to tackle the most
demanding industrial challenges. Our state-of-the-art ultrasonic cleaners are engineered for
precision, utilizing advanced cavitation technology to ensure unparalleled cleaning efficiency. We
serve a diverse range of critical sectors, including automotive, aerospace, medical device
manufacturing, electronics, and precision optics, where microscopic cleanliness is non-negotiable.

Beyond complete cleaning systems, we are a leading global provider of core ultrasonic hardware. Our
extensive product portfolio includes high-Q piezoelectric ultrasonic transducers, robust digital
ultrasonic generators with automatic frequency tracking, and advanced ultrasonic mist makers for
industrial atomization. By leveraging rigorous quality control and innovative sweep frequency
technologies, our components guarantee 24/7 continuous, heavy-duty operation with maximum energy
transfer and minimal heat generation. Whether you require standard 28kHz or 40kHz piezoelectric
components, high-frequency megasonic sensors, or specialized ultrasonic humidification solutions,
our factory delivers unmatched reliability and acoustic stability.

Understanding that every industrial workflow requires specific technical parameters, Beijing
Ultrasonic specializes in highly flexible OEM and ODM manufacturing services. We offer full
customization across all product lines—from bespoke tank dimensions and multi-frequency power
supplies to specialized transducer arrays and private labeling. Our large-scale production facility
in China ensures rapid prototyping, rigorous testing, and fast global deployment. Serving
professional clients across more than 50 countries, we are committed to seamlessly integrating our
advanced industrial ultrasonic technologies into your supply chain, providing the
precision-engineered durability and technical innovation your business demands to stay competitive
in the global market.

### Ultrasonic Applications

#### Plastic & Rubber Welding

Achieve fast, reliable, and glue-free ultrasonic welding, riveting, and forming of complex
thermoplastic parts.

#### Automobile & Aerospace

Degreasing and cleaning of engine parts, fuel injectors, and aviation bearings; ultrasonic welding
of automotive plastic components.

#### Medical & Pharmaceutical

Thorough cleaning and sterilization of surgical instruments, dental tools; extraction of active
pharmaceutical ingredients.

#### Watch, Jewelry & Optics

Non-destructive, ultra-fine cleaning of precious jewelry, delicate watch movements, and optical
lenses without scratching.

#### Musical Instruments

Deep cleaning of brass and woodwind instruments to remove internal dirt and maintain optimal
acoustic performance and longevity.

#### Semiconductor & Electronics

Precision cleaning of PCBs, silicon wafers, microchips, and electronic components; ultrasonic wire
bonding.

#### Machining, Hardware & Surface Finishing

Deep removal of oil, grease, rust, and polishing paste from metal parts before electroplating or
coating.

#### Textile & Non-Woven Fabrics

Seamless ultrasonic sewing, cutting, and lace making for medical masks, protective clothing, and
packaging bags.

#### Food & Beverage Processing

Precise ultrasonic cutting for bakery, cheese, and frozen foods; defoaming and liquid homogenizing.

#### Chemical & Laboratory

Ultrasonic cell disruption, emulsification, dispersion of nanomaterials (like graphene), and
accelerating chemical reactions.

#### New Energy & Battery Manufacturing

High-speed ultrasonic welding of lithium battery tabs and copper/aluminum foils; dispersion of solar
cell coatings.

#### Non-Destructive Testing - NDT

Accurate ultrasonic flaw detection and thickness measurement for critical welds, pipelines, and
pressure vessels.

#### Environmental & Water Treatment

Ultrasonic degradation of difficult organic pollutants in wastewater, algae removal, and sludge
disintegration.

#### Metallurgy & Powder Materials

Ultrasonic degassing and grain refinement of metals; vibrating screens for ultra-fine powder
separation.

#### Petrochemical & Heavy Industry

Reducing heavy oil viscosity, preventing pipeline scaling, and accelerating crude demulsification
and dehydration.

## Beijing Ultrasonic: Your Global Partner for Advanced Ultrasonic Engineering

Beijing Ultrasonic stands at the forefront of acoustic engineering, delivering high-performance
industrial ultrasonic cleaning equipment and core components to a global market. With over 15 years
of dedicated manufacturing expertise, we provide comprehensive solutions designed to tackle the most
demanding industrial challenges. Our state-of-the-art ultrasonic cleaners are engineered for
precision, utilizing advanced cavitation technology to ensure unparalleled cleaning efficiency. We
serve a diverse range of critical sectors, including automotive, aerospace, medical device
manufacturing, electronics, and precision optics, where microscopic cleanliness is non-negotiable.

Beyond complete cleaning systems, we are a leading global provider of core ultrasonic hardware. Our
extensive product portfolio includes high-Q piezoelectric ultrasonic transducers, robust digital
ultrasonic generators with automatic frequency tracking, and advanced ultrasonic mist makers for
industrial atomization. By leveraging rigorous quality control and innovative sweep frequency
technologies, our components guarantee 24/7 continuous, heavy-duty operation with maximum energy
transfer and minimal heat generation. Whether you require standard 28kHz or 40kHz piezoelectric
components, high-frequency megasonic sensors, or specialized ultrasonic humidification solutions,
our factory delivers unmatched reliability and acoustic stability.

Understanding that every industrial workflow requires specific technical parameters, Beijing
Ultrasonic specializes in highly flexible OEM and ODM manufacturing services. We offer full
customization across all product lines—from bespoke tank dimensions and multi-frequency power
supplies to specialized transducer arrays and private labeling. Our large-scale production facility
in China ensures rapid prototyping, rigorous testing, and fast global deployment. Serving
professional clients across more than 50 countries, we are committed to seamlessly integrating our
advanced industrial ultrasonic technologies into your supply chain, providing the
precision-engineered durability and technical innovation your business demands to stay competitive
in the global market.

### Ultrasonic Applications

#### Plastic & Rubber Welding

Achieve fast, reliable, and glue-free ultrasonic welding, riveting, and forming of complex
thermoplastic parts.

#### Automobile & Aerospace

Degreasing and cleaning of engine parts, fuel injectors, and aviation bearings; ultrasonic welding
of automotive plastic components.

#### Medical & Pharmaceutical

Thorough cleaning and sterilization of surgical instruments, dental tools; extraction of active
pharmaceutical ingredients.

#### Watch, Jewelry & Optics

Non-destructive, ultra-fine cleaning of precious jewelry, delicate watch movements, and optical
lenses without scratching.

#### Musical Instruments

Deep cleaning of brass and woodwind instruments to remove internal dirt and maintain optimal
acoustic performance and longevity.

#### Semiconductor & Electronics

Precision cleaning of PCBs, silicon wafers, microchips, and electronic components; ultrasonic wire
bonding.

#### Machining, Hardware & Surface Finishing

Deep removal of oil, grease, rust, and polishing paste from metal parts before electroplating or
coating.

#### Textile & Non-Woven Fabrics

Seamless ultrasonic sewing, cutting, and lace making for medical masks, protective clothing, and
packaging bags.

#### Food & Beverage Processing

Precise ultrasonic cutting for bakery, cheese, and frozen foods; defoaming and liquid homogenizing.

#### Chemical & Laboratory

Ultrasonic cell disruption, emulsification, dispersion of nanomaterials (like graphene), and
accelerating chemical reactions.

#### New Energy & Battery Manufacturing

High-speed ultrasonic welding of lithium battery tabs and copper/aluminum foils; dispersion of solar
cell coatings.

#### Non-Destructive Testing - NDT

Accurate ultrasonic flaw detection and thickness measurement for critical welds, pipelines, and
pressure vessels.

#### Environmental & Water Treatment

Ultrasonic degradation of difficult organic pollutants in wastewater, algae removal, and sludge
disintegration.

#### Metallurgy & Powder Materials

Ultrasonic degassing and grain refinement of metals; vibrating screens for ultra-fine powder
separation.

#### Petrochemical & Heavy Industry

Reducing heavy oil viscosity, preventing pipeline scaling, and accelerating crude demulsification
and dehydration.

Ingredient (API) manufacturing company, has suc-cessfully commissioned a new ground-mounted

underscores its long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]

  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

“Our vibration energy harvesting technology can eliminate the need for coin cell batteries in
wearables for athletes.”
“Our vibration energy harvesting
technology can eliminate the need
for recharging in wearables.”
Our energy harvesting technology is born from research at the University of Michigan in novel
integrated circuits.

### Creathadh Energies is funded with a Phase I National Science Foundation SBIR grant. It was
### founded to commercialize its founder James McCullagh’s PhD research in vibration energy
### harvesting originating at the University of Michigan.

This research’s sponsors include the National Science Foundation, the Department of Education, and
the National Institute of Standards and Technology.

[
][15]

### Technology

#### Originally developed for vibration energy harvesting on suspension bridges, Creathadh Energies
#### has developed a novel patented interface circuit of an electromagnetic vibration energy
#### harvester. We pivoted to wearables for athletes because of the similarities between the
#### frequency profiles of cars going over a suspension bridge and an athlete training.

Since 2014, our pioneering Ambient Energy Managers (AEMs) have already helped many businesses to

## How does it work?

[Harvesting scheme][Harvesting scheme]
[AEM chip][AEM chip]
[Pile][Pile]

#### What is energy harvesting?

Energy harvesting is a process of collecting raw energy from ambient energy sources and convert it
into a usable form.


This process involves an energy harvester that transforms ambient energy into electrical power,
along with an AEM and a rechargeable storage element.

#### What is an AEM?

An Ambient Energy Manager, also known as Power Management Integrated Circuit (PMIC), is a key
component of an energy harvesting system.

 

It manages power from the energy harvester to the storage element and, eventually, to a low-power
hardware device. By efficiently managing available power with minimal losses, the AEM enables
harvesting power from ambient sources, making it perfect for IoT device.

## How does it work?

[Harvesting scheme][Harvesting scheme]
[AEM chip][AEM chip]
[Pile][Pile]

#### What is energy harvesting?

Energy harvesting is a process of collecting raw energy from ambient energy sources and convert it
into a usable form.


This process involves an energy harvester that transforms ambient energy into electrical power,
along with an AEM and a rechargeable storage element.

#### What is an AEM?

An Ambient Energy Manager, also known as Power Management Integrated Circuit (PMIC), is a key
component of an energy harvesting system.

 

It manages power from the energy harvester to the storage element and, eventually, to a low-power
hardware device. By efficiently managing available power with minimal losses, the AEM enables
harvesting power from ambient sources, making it perfect for IoT device.

# Energy Harvesting haute performance pour l’IoT

## IoT sans batterie

## Énergie durable pour 50 milliards d’objets connectés

L’**Energy Harvesting** est l’**art de récupérer une partie de l’énergie présente dans
l’environnement**, de la transformer et de la gérer. Elle est une réponse aux **enjeux immenses de
production et de consommation d’énergie** des quelques **50 milliards d’objets connectés** estimés
dans le monde en 2020.

**Sans fil, sans batterie** et conçue sur cette **technologie**, l’Energy Harvesting produit de
**l’énergie durable**. Elle permet ainsi d’éviter le changement annuel de 50 milliards de batteries.

La [**technologie d’Energy Harvesting d’Enerbee Technology**][16] est unique dans sa capacité à
**générer de l’énergie** à partir de mouvements à faible vitesse et faible couple, **là où aucune
autre technologie ne fonctionne**.

L’énergie générée de l’ordre **de 1mW à 10mW** permet d’alimenter des **capteurs**, des actionneurs
et d’assurer une **communication sans fils avec les objets**.

 

[Découvrir l’IoT sans batteries d’Enerbee Technology][17]

## Innovation

## Innovation en Energy Harvesting pour l’IoT

La génération **d’énergie accessible à partir de faibles mouvements**.

La **technologie Enerbee** **Technology** repose sur une solution unique de **micro générateur basée
sur le mouvement**. Il devient donc possible de générer des milliwatts d’énergie à partir de
mouvements de rotation ou de translation de faibles amplitudes.

C’est grâce à l’association unique de matériaux **piézoélectriques** avec des matériaux
**magnétostrictifs** qu’il est possible de générer plusieurs centaines de microjoules à partir de
seulement quelques rotations.

La **technologie Enerbee Technology** permet l’installation de dispositifs sans batteries,
**autonomes en énergie et sans fils**, apportant de l’intelligence et de nouvelles fonctionnalités
de traitement de données localisées (edge computing) dans les applications.

 

[En savoir plus sur l’innovation d’Enerbee Technology][18]


Applications

## La technologie Enerbee Technology au service de différents secteurs

[Image HVAC Smart Ventilation]

### HVAC Smart Ventilation

Les réglementations et la prise de conscience du grand public face à l’importance de la qualité de
l’air intérieure conduisent à l’amélioration des systèmes de ventilation au-delà des concepts
classiques. Il devient nécessaire d’installer des dispositifs intelligents de vérification de bon
fonctionnement des installations de ventilation. L’accès à une technologie permettant l’autonomie
des systèmes et donc sans maintenance spécifique favorise l’adoption de ces nouveaux dispositifs.
La technologie Enerbee Technology permet l’installation de dispositifs sans batteries et autonomes
en énergie apportant de l’intelligence, de nouvelles fonctionnalités et du monitoring aux systèmes
HVAC .

[Découvrir nos propositions de valeur pour la Ventilation][19]
[Image Industrie 4.0]

### Industrie 4.0

Des multiples lignes de production complexes, des cadences élevées, de l’auto diagnostique et de la
surveillance permanente sont le quotidien de notre industrie. L’optimisation de la production et de
la logistique passe par l’intégration de capteurs par l’instrumentation des machines existantes et
déjà installées.

L’utilisation du micro générateur Enerbee permet l’alimentation de dispositifs de contrôles sans
perturbation ou interruption des chaines de productions.

[Découvrir nos propositions de valeur pour l' Industrie 4.0][20]
[Image Mobility et Smart City]

### Mobility et Smart City

L’optimisation de nos moyens de transports et l’accroissement des services digitaux nécessitent
l’installation de capteurs autonomes (présence, vitesses, température, …) qui se doivent de
transmettre leurs informations via les réseaux de communications sans fils à un système de gestion
et d’intelligence centralisé.

La communication radio fréquence et l’alimentation électrique sans fil ni batterie est possible
grâce au micro générateur Enerbee. C’est la garantie d’un système de communication fiable,
économique et sans entretient.

[Découvrir nos propositions de valeur pour la Mobilité & Smart City][21]

# Energy Harvesting haute performance pour l’IoT

## IoT sans batterie

## Énergie durable pour 50 milliards d’objets connectés

L’**Energy Harvesting** est l’**art de récupérer une partie de l’énergie présente dans
l’environnement**, de la transformer et de la gérer. Elle est une réponse aux **enjeux immenses de
production et de consommation d’énergie** des quelques **50 milliards d’objets connectés** estimés
dans le monde en 2020.

**Sans fil, sans batterie** et conçue sur cette **technologie**, l’Energy Harvesting produit de
**l’énergie durable**. Elle permet ainsi d’éviter le changement annuel de 50 milliards de batteries.

La [**technologie d’Energy Harvesting d’Enerbee Technology**][16] est unique dans sa capacité à
**générer de l’énergie** à partir de mouvements à faible vitesse et faible couple, **là où aucune
autre technologie ne fonctionne**.

L’énergie générée de l’ordre **de 1mW à 10mW** permet d’alimenter des **capteurs**, des actionneurs
et d’assurer une **communication sans fils avec les objets**.

 

[Découvrir l’IoT sans batteries d’Enerbee Technology][17]

## Innovation

## Innovation en Energy Harvesting pour l’IoT

La génération **d’énergie accessible à partir de faibles mouvements**.

La **technologie Enerbee** **Technology** repose sur une solution unique de **micro générateur basée
sur le mouvement**. Il devient donc possible de générer des milliwatts d’énergie à partir de
mouvements de rotation ou de translation de faibles amplitudes.

C’est grâce à l’association unique de matériaux **piézoélectriques** avec des matériaux
**magnétostrictifs** qu’il est possible de générer plusieurs centaines de microjoules à partir de
seulement quelques rotations.

La **technologie Enerbee Technology** permet l’installation de dispositifs sans batteries,
**autonomes en énergie et sans fils**, apportant de l’intelligence et de nouvelles fonctionnalités
de traitement de données localisées (edge computing) dans les applications.

 

[En savoir plus sur l’innovation d’Enerbee Technology][18]


Applications

## La technologie Enerbee Technology au service de différents secteurs

[Image HVAC Smart Ventilation]

### HVAC Smart Ventilation

Les réglementations et la prise de conscience du grand public face à l’importance de la qualité de
l’air intérieure conduisent à l’amélioration des systèmes de ventilation au-delà des concepts
classiques. Il devient nécessaire d’installer des dispositifs intelligents de vérification de bon
fonctionnement des installations de ventilation. L’accès à une technologie permettant l’autonomie
des systèmes et donc sans maintenance spécifique favorise l’adoption de ces nouveaux dispositifs.
La technologie Enerbee Technology permet l’installation de dispositifs sans batteries et autonomes
en énergie apportant de l’intelligence, de nouvelles fonctionnalités et du monitoring aux systèmes
HVAC .

[Découvrir nos propositions de valeur pour la Ventilation][19]
[Image Industrie 4.0]

### Industrie 4.0

Des multiples lignes de production complexes, des cadences élevées, de l’auto diagnostique et de la
surveillance permanente sont le quotidien de notre industrie. L’optimisation de la production et de
la logistique passe par l’intégration de capteurs par l’instrumentation des machines existantes et
déjà installées.

L’utilisation du micro générateur Enerbee permet l’alimentation de dispositifs de contrôles sans
perturbation ou interruption des chaines de productions.

[Découvrir nos propositions de valeur pour l' Industrie 4.0][20]
[Image Mobility et Smart City]

### Mobility et Smart City

L’optimisation de nos moyens de transports et l’accroissement des services digitaux nécessitent
l’installation de capteurs autonomes (présence, vitesses, température, …) qui se doivent de
transmettre leurs informations via les réseaux de communications sans fils à un système de gestion
et d’intelligence centralisé.

La communication radio fréquence et l’alimentation électrique sans fil ni batterie est possible
grâce au micro générateur Enerbee. C’est la garantie d’un système de communication fiable,
économique et sans entretient.

[Découvrir nos propositions de valeur pour la Mobilité & Smart City][21]

## Enerbee Technology

**Une start-up innovante et verte**

Basée au sein du pôle technologique Grenoblois, Enerbee Technology ([groupe F2A)][22] est un acteur
incontournable des systèmes autonomes en énergie. Se basant sur une technologie unique permettant de
générer de 1 à 10mW d’énergie, Enerbee Technology peut donc, en étroite collaboration avec les
acteurs de ses marchés, développer des systèmes électroniques autonomes en énergie. La société est
donc présente sur des secteurs clés que sont la qualité de l’air intérieur, l’industrie 4.0, les
villes intelligentes et les transports.

 

[Découvrir Enerbee Technology][23]

E
New website in development

KINETIC ENERGY HARVESTING

# Energy from motion.
# *Data without battery dependency.*

Enervibe develops energy harvesting and battery-less sensing platforms that convert vibration,
rotation and motion into usable electrical power for connected products.

[Start a conversation][8] [Explore our focus][9]
[Tire with an Enervibe sensing module mounted inside]
01 HARVEST
02 SENSE
03 CONNECT
**2018** Founded in Israel
**12** Patents
**Tire-grade** Platform validation
**End-to-end** From energy to data

WHO WE ARE

## From physics lab to commercial deployment.

Enervibe is a deep-tech company developing kinetic energy harvesting technologies and integrated
sensing solutions. Our systems are designed to power wireless electronics from the motion already
present in their operating environment.

The platform has been validated inside the rotating tire, one of the most demanding environments for
electronics, and is now being adapted for industrial and wearable applications.

WHERE WE WORK

## One technology platform.
## Multiple product categories.

High-level solutions for markets where battery replacement, charging and access limit the value of
connected sensing.

[
01

### Automotive

Self-powered sensing for tires, rotating systems and connected mobility platforms.

Explore automotive → ][10]
02

### Industrial IoT

Energy harvesting for wireless monitoring, condition-based maintenance and industrial sensing.

03

### Smart Wearables

Embedded energy and sensing platforms for footwear and next-generation wearable devices.

04

### Product Integration

Harvester, power management, sensing and wireless integration developed as one system.

THE PLATFORM

## From ambient motion to actionable data.

Our approach connects the energy source, low-power electronics and data layer into a single product
architecture.

THE DIFFERENCE Enervibe works across the complete system instead of treating the harvester as an
isolated component.
01

### Harvest

Convert vibration, motion or rotation into electrical energy.

02

### Manage

Condition, store and deliver power within the available energy budget.

03

### Sense

Operate ultra-low-power sensors matched to the application.

04

### Connect

Transmit meaningful data through an optimized wireless architecture.

[Enervibe tire-mounted energy harvesting module]

VALIDATED IN MOTION

## Proven in the rotating tire.
## Built to scale beyond it.

The tire combines continuous vibration, rotation, shock, temperature variation and zero-access
operation. Validation in this environment provides a strong foundation for adjacent products with
less severe operating conditions.

NEW WEBSITE COMING SOON

## We are updating the way we present Enervibe.

Our full website is currently under development. For technology partnerships, product integration or
company information, contact our team directly.

  fan cooling method?
  May Mon, 2023
  The AirJet cooling chip is designed to solve the cooling problem that limits CPU performance in
  today's notebook computers. It is a so-called "solid-state cooling solution" that completely
  abandons the traditional cooling method of fans. Frore Systems said: "The inside of the AirJet is
  a tiny piezoelectric film made using MEMS technology that vibrates at ultrasonic frequencies, and
  then these piezoelectric films generate a strong airflow, allowing cold air to enter the AirJet
  cooling chip through the top vents and flow from the sides. The vents take away the heat generated
  by the processor. A single air particle can fly over the cooling chip at a speed of 200 kilometers
  per hour.

  [Solid-state cooling chip based on piezoelectric MEMS: is it expected to subvert the traditional

  Solid-state cooling chip based on piezoelectric MEMS: is it expected to subvert the traditional
  fan cooling method?
  May Mon, 2023
  The AirJet cooling chip is designed to solve the cooling problem that limits CPU performance in
  today's notebook computers. It is a so-called "solid-state cooling solution" that completely
  abandons the traditional cooling method of fans. Frore Systems said: "The inside of the AirJet is
  a tiny piezoelectric film made using MEMS technology that vibrates at ultrasonic frequencies, and
  then these piezoelectric films generate a strong airflow, allowing cold air to enter the AirJet
  cooling chip through the top vents and flow from the sides. The vents take away the heat generated
  by the processor. A single air particle can fly over the cooling chip at a speed of 200 kilometers
  per hour.
  Learn more
  ][74]

## About

### Short bio

I’m with [Ericsson][20] in Stockholm, Sweden.

Previously, I was a Postdoctoral Researcher at [Chalmers University of Techonology][21], Gothenburg,
Sweden, where I worked with [Giuseppe Durisi][22] on several topics in information theory.

Prior to moving back to Europe, I held an [SUTD-MIT Postdoctoral Fellowship][23], and I spent one
year at the [Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)][24], Singapore, and one year at
the [Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)][25], MA, USA, where I worked with [Tony Q. S.
Quek][26] and [Moe Z. Win][27] on topics in wireless communications and networks.

Previously, I earned a double Ph.D. degree jointly at [Sapienza Università di Roma][28], Italy, and
[CentraleSupélec][29] ([Université Paris-Saclay][30]), France. The topic of my doctorate revolved
around the impact of sparsity in communications.

I am interested in information theory, machine learning, and more broadly in mathematics and
computer science, with a particular emphasis on discrete probability and multivariate statistics.

### Short bio

I’m with [Ericsson][20] in Stockholm, Sweden.

Previously, I was a Postdoctoral Researcher at [Chalmers University of Techonology][21], Gothenburg,
Sweden, where I worked with [Giuseppe Durisi][22] on several topics in information theory.

Prior to moving back to Europe, I held an [SUTD-MIT Postdoctoral Fellowship][23], and I spent one
year at the [Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)][24], Singapore, and one year at
the [Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)][25], MA, USA, where I worked with [Tony Q. S.
Quek][26] and [Moe Z. Win][27] on topics in wireless communications and networks.

Previously, I earned a double Ph.D. degree jointly at [Sapienza Università di Roma][28], Italy, and
[CentraleSupélec][29] ([Université Paris-Saclay][30]), France. The topic of my doctorate revolved

# International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology (IJRASET)

**It is an international peer-reviewed, open-access and multidisciplinary online journal published
for the enhancement of research in various disciplines of Applied Science & Engineering
Technologies.**

**

We publish original and high-quality research papers. IJRASET has many benefits all geared toward
strengthening research skills and advancing academic careers. Journal publications are a vital part
of academic career advancement. All the published papers are submitted to the major indexing
services for indexing.

IJRASET Journal is a multidisciplinary peer-reviewed, UGC CARE recognized, refereed journal with
high impact factor and low publication fee. We also implemented a truly open access publication
model that provides open global access to its published material so that anyone can download and
read articles free of charge around the clock.

IJRASET relies 100% on high-quality science materials, a rigorous peer review analysis of all our
research and evaluation papers, ensuring that technology-based research is conducted across a wide
variety of engineering fields.

**Frequency:** 12 Issues per year (Monthly)

**Subject Categories:** Applied Science & Engineering Technology
* Open Access Peer-Reviewed Journal- No Subscription to access papers
* Best International Journal for Research Publication, Best Journal in India
* Fast Track Paper Publication Journal with a smooth and transparent process
* Indexed with Crossref for DOI & DOI for each Published Research Paper
* Indexed with [Google Scholar][81], [Academia.edu][82], [Issuu][83], [Scribd][84], Research Gate
* Best Academic Journal with major indexing that helps to increase citations
* Best International Journal for Paper Publication- Certified Journal
* Support and Guidance for students in regards to preparing & publish research papers
* Impact Factor- ISRAJIF and SJIF, Zero Tolerance Policy against Plagiarism, Referred by
  Indianscience.in

International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology (IJRASET) is open
access, multidisciplinary engineering, technology and science peer-reviewed publication journal that
publishes original studies and review papers from all major engineering, science and technology
divisions.

IJRASET does not charge for access to more than 35000 published papers to subscribers or their
institutions. Open access gives users the ability to read, view, copy, share, publish, browse or
link to the full text of these documents, provided that they are correctly recognized and
referenced.

For all fields pertaining to applied sciences, engineering and technology, we approve research
papers or review papers. At IJRASET, we delegate each article to DOI by crossref to help writers get
more exposure and quotes. We are also linked to the world's leading association for developing
science promotion work, which will also help writers achieve more internet exposure.

IJRASET specifically meets UGC Care, AICTE, SCI, WoS, Scopus Journal Reputation Enhancement
Criteria, ranking, acceptance, and potential recognition. As per UGC Care guidelines, our plagiarism
policy is established. We have a strong and reputable team of reviewers from different nations, such
as India, China, the USA, the UK, Canada, etc.

model that provides open global access to its published material so that anyone can download and
read articles free of charge around the clock.

IJRASET relies 100% on high-quality science materials, a rigorous peer review analysis of all our
research and evaluation papers, ensuring that technology-based research is conducted across a wide
variety of engineering fields.

International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology (IJRASET) is open
access, multidisciplinary engineering, technology and science peer-reviewed publication journal that
publishes original studies and review papers from all major engineering, science and technology
divisions.

IJRASET does not charge for access to more than 35000 published papers to subscribers or their
institutions. Open access gives users the ability to read, view, copy, share, publish, browse or
link to the full text of these documents, provided that they are correctly recognized and
referenced.

For all fields pertaining to applied sciences, engineering and technology, we approve research
papers or review papers. At IJRASET, we delegate each article to DOI by crossref to help writers get
more exposure and quotes. We are also linked to the world's leading association for developing
science promotion work, which will also help writers achieve more internet exposure.

IJRASET specifically meets UGC Care, AICTE, SCI, WoS, Scopus Journal Reputation Enhancement
Criteria, ranking, acceptance, and potential recognition. As per UGC Care guidelines, our plagiarism
policy is established. We have a strong and reputable team of reviewers from different nations, such
as India, China, the USA, the UK, Canada, etc.
